book.title: Luka Iifa Faunina Iesu Fouga Luka Epapua Auga

content: Iudea Au Akaikiꞌaꞌi Auꞌi Iesu Isaupugua Kefagaisa
Egae kai palafa ipaufuga mulamula laaꞌi kai palafa maini mo keania auga miamiaga aka Pasover emai ekaialiali.
Egaꞌina alogai sakedote lopiaꞌi ke Moses ega iifa pamalelega auꞌi fou papiau kemaniꞌiainiꞌi kainai, ogefakeai Iesu fekeaupugua keoma keagaga kekapunia.
Ega aisama Iesu ega apostolo 12 epoꞌiai agaꞌo aka Judas Iskariot keoma auga alogai Satani ekoko.
Ke isa sakedote lopiaꞌi ke Deo ega eꞌa keꞌima kaniagai auꞌi eeꞌi elao, Iesu ala ageꞌafaꞌafalai oma auga fouga keifania.
Ega aisama egaꞌina papiauꞌi aloꞌi egama alogaina, ke kelogo moni fekepenia keoma.
Ke isa kapaꞌina keifania auga Judas felo eoma puo ainaꞌi eafiia. Ke elao keaga agaꞌo ekapunia laꞌafou afaemia aisama, Iesu feꞌafaꞌafalaina isa imaꞌiai fepaaua eoma.
Pasover Foꞌamaga Kepafua Eka
Egaꞌina afegai palafa ipaufuga mulamula laaꞌi kai, palafa maini mo keania miamiaga aka Pasover ke sipi gauga Deo kepaꞌa penia auga kina emai ekainia.
Ega aisama Iesu ega apostolo Peto, Ioane auniꞌi epainiꞌi einaka, “Amoufai amolao iꞌa fauꞌaisai Pasover miamiagai foꞌama agaania auga opafua gaka,” eoma. Egae kai eulaiꞌi kelao.
Ega aisama isa Iesu kepaꞌani penia keinaka, “Anina loani kapai egaꞌina foꞌamaga fapafua feka looma?” keoma.
Ke Iesu einaka, “Agolao Ierusaleme taoninai agokoko mo alogai, au agaꞌo oga eafiia fei eakoaua epuaisa auga fou agopiaogai. Isa muninai folao eꞌa kapagai agekoko auga foisa.
Egae kai folao eꞌa inagome auga fopaina foinaka, ‘Pamalele auga epaꞌani, lau eꞌu imoi fou Pasover miamiaga foꞌamaga faania laoma kai, lai fofougai agaaniani auga afuga kapai?’ fooma.
Ke isa eꞌa auꞌoniai, afu akaikiꞌagai amu maꞌoai epafuaꞌi auga agepakinaimi. Ke folao egae miamia foꞌamaꞌi fopafuaꞌi fekeka,” eoma.
Ke Peto Ioane auniꞌi kelao, ke Iesu kapaꞌina maaꞌiai eifania auga iꞌopoga mo emia keisa. Ega puo egae Pasover foꞌamaga, ke amu maꞌoai kepafuaꞌi keka.
Iesu Ega Imoi Fou Keaniani Fua
Egae kai aniani kina maaga ekainia aisama, Iesu ega apostolo 12 fou kelao teipoloai keagukipo.
Ke Iesu isa epainiꞌi einaka, “Iifa gome maamiai laifania. Lau alakiekie koa kai oi fou Pasover miamiagai faaniani auga alou koꞌagai anina laani.
Gome lau oi fou afalaaniani pugu agelao Pasover miamiaga pau aagoai akapa, Deo kaniami ageagamauga auga gouga muni ufai koꞌa ipauma mo agemia kai fou agaaniani pugu,” eoma.
Egae kai Iesu fino kaputina eafiia Deo maagai tenkiu eifania kai epainiꞌi einaka, “Fino kaputina iꞌina amoafia epomiai amoꞌea amoinu.
Gome fino iꞌina au puagai emai auga afalainu pugu agelaolao muni Deo ega logoai kapa maꞌoai akefua afegai, Deo ega agofaꞌai kai alainu pugu,” eoma.

Egae kai palafa eafiia Deo maagai tenkiu eifania, efaipoga kai ega imoi epainiꞌi einaka, “Iꞌina palafaga auga lau imaau oi faumiai alapipeni auga. Muni iina koa agokapa aisama, foopolaniau kai fokapa,” eoma.

Ega koa iꞌopoga, keaniani efua aisama Iesu fino kaputina eafiiakae kai ega imoi epainiꞌi einaka, “Iꞌina fino kaputina auga oi faumiai lau ifau agefaka auga. Ke Deo oi fou epomiai pakoꞌa kapula iifaga mamaga gouga lakapaisa.
Kai amoisa! Epomiai aufalao agaꞌo lau ageꞌafaꞌafalainiau auga isafa inae fou aague. Egaꞌina auga lau fou foꞌama agaꞌomo agaania auga.
Papiau Aumauni Gauga auga Deo ega logoai femae eoma puo agemae kai, kaisau isa ageꞌafaꞌafalaina auga, Deo isa afa apala ipauma agepenia,” eoma.
Ega aisama Iesu ega apostolo ifoꞌi mo epoꞌiai kaisau ega koa agekapa auga paꞌanina kepaꞌani.
Ke isa epoꞌiai papiau maaꞌiai kaisau au akaikiꞌa agemia auga isafa akekua kepaꞌaua.
Ega aisama Iesu isa epainiꞌi einaka, “Agofaꞌa papiauꞌi eꞌi kin isa kelopialainiꞌi, ke isapuai papiau keꞌimaꞌi auꞌi ifoꞌi keifaniꞌi papiau fauꞌiai kapa feloꞌi mo kekapaꞌi auꞌi keoma.
Kai oi auga egaꞌina papiauꞌi koa folomia. Oi epomiai kaisau Deo maagai au akaikiꞌa gamia eoma auga ifo eꞌele fepamia. Ke kaisau papiau eꞌimaꞌi auga, papiau feopolaniꞌi fauꞌiai fepinauga.

Amoisa! Iꞌina papiauꞌi epoꞌiai kaisau auga au akaikiꞌa ooma? Eagukipo eaniani auga, o foꞌama eꞌea auga? Iifa gome eagukipo eaniani auga au akaikiꞌa. Kai lau oi epomiai foꞌama iꞌea auga koa iꞌopoga lamia oi faumiai lapinauga.
Lau kina apalaꞌi aloꞌiai lakoko iꞌopo laafiiꞌi mo ganinagai, alopuaꞌafuniau fou kaiꞌalao aagu.
Ke Amau ega agofaꞌa lau epeniiau faꞌima eoma koa iꞌopoga, oi isafa apumi alapenimi agoꞌima.
Ega koa oi lau eꞌu agofaꞌai fou faagu faaniani, ke papiau foꞌimaꞌi isapuga foafia foagu, Israel ikupuga 12 papiauꞌi eꞌi laomai afa fopeniꞌi laoma,” eoma.
Peto Iesu Agepuniaiaina Auga Fouga
Egae kai Iesu Saimon eifaga kai epainia einaka, “Saimon, Saimon akiuagai, Satani Deo egoi penia elogo oi palafa kepagopo koa iꞌopoga feꞌopoiso eoma.

Kai Saimon, Satani ageꞌopoiso alogai, kapaꞌina lopakoꞌania auga eegai foloꞌualai laoma puo faumuai lamegamega. Kai oi aloꞌualai mo ganinagai, alomu agekapula alopakoꞌaniau pugu aisama, aamu akimu eꞌi pakoꞌa fopakapulania,” eoma.
Kai Saimon iifa epamue einaka, “Lopia, lau lafua laague oi fotipula ma, fomae mo ganinagai fou agalao paisa,” eoma.
Ega aisama Iesu einaka, “Peto, iifa gome maamuai laifania. Pau oꞌolo aeagaga koa kai, oi lau alologoniau auga puniaina oiso alopamia,” eoma.

Egae kai Iesu isa maꞌoai epaꞌani peniꞌi einaka, “Oi laulaimi mo alogai, paoti, feꞌa, o kamata iꞌoina agaꞌo aloafia alogai kapa agaꞌo eegai oafiꞌafu ma?” eoma. Ke isa iifa kepamue keinaka, “Laaꞌi,” keoma.

Ega aisama Iesu isa epainiꞌi pugu einaka, “Pau amofua amoagu paoti, o feꞌa eemiai kekae koa aisama amoafiꞌi, ke ifani aꞌifaꞌi eemiai laaꞌi koa aisama, afemi tiapuꞌi amoꞌafaꞌafalainiꞌi ifani aꞌifaꞌi amoꞌafaꞌi.

Gome Deo ega iifa pukagai iina kepapua oma: ‘Isa laomai apalaꞌi kekapakapa auꞌi epoꞌiai kepaapauka laomai apala ikapa auga kepamia.’ Egaꞌina iifaga auga pau lau faagauai koꞌa mo agemia alamae. Ke iifa gome lau faagauai kapaꞌina agemia kepapua auga kina emai ekainia,” eoma.

Iesu ega eifa oma aisama, ega imoi isa kepainia keinaka, “Lopia, lai afua aague, aꞌifa auniꞌi inamoꞌe moisaꞌi,” keoma. Ke Iesu kapaꞌina eifania auga ega imoi oko akelogo auga eisa aisama, iifa epamue einaka, “Moꞌo ekainia,” eoma.
Iesu Olifa Ikugai Emegamega Fua
Egae kai Iesu Olifa ikuga elaolao koa iꞌopoga elao, ke ega apostolo 11 isafa muninai kelao.
Ke kelao Iesu elaolao auga afugai kepealai aisama epainiꞌi einaka, “Amomegamega ega koa Satani ageꞌopoimi aisama afoloꞌualai,” eoma.
Egae kai Iesu ega imoi epuaꞌafuniꞌi, kepo kepiuga elao eꞌualai koa iꞌopoga epo, egae eanifeꞌu emegamega einaka;
“Amau, anina loani koa aisama, iꞌina kiekie akaikiꞌa kaputina eeuai moafia. Kai lau anina laani auga faeikapa kai oi anina loani auga mo gaikapa,” eoma.
Ega aisama ufai agelo agaꞌo isa eapakina penia alo epakapulania.
Iesu faagagai kapaꞌina agemia auga eopolaga ekiekie alogaina mo ganinagai, alo koꞌa ipaumagai emegamega. Egaꞌina alogai mamaoge ifa elolo koa iꞌopoga elolo eake aꞌisaai.
Ke Iesu emegamega efua aisama, eꞌue emue ega imoi eeꞌi elao kai kefeu eisaꞌi aisama, alo emafu alogaina.
Ke epagoniꞌi kai epaꞌani peniꞌi einaka, “Kapa puo ofeu? Amoꞌue amomegamega ega koa Satani ageꞌopoimi aisama afoloꞌualai,” eoma.
Iesu Keafiia Kegopeisa

Iesu ega imoi epaipainiꞌi kai, papiau isaꞌi laꞌafouai Iesu ega imoi fou keagu afuga kemai. Egaꞌina laꞌafouga auga Iesu ega apostolo 12 epoꞌiai agaꞌo aka Judas keoma auga eoge isa epapeaꞌi kemai. Ke kemai aisama, Judas Iesu eega elao kagakaga kainai egoapia.
Kai Iesu Judas epaꞌani penia einaka, “Judas, oi Papiau Aumauni Gauga pigoapiai ma foꞌafaꞌafalaina looma?” eoma.
Egaꞌina alogai Iesu fou keapa auꞌi kapaꞌina agemia auga keisa aisama, Iesu kepainia keinaka, “Lopia, oi anina loani, lai emai ifani aꞌifaꞌiai isa amaauniꞌi looma ma?” keoma.
Ke fiakoa mo epoꞌiai apostolo agaꞌo aꞌifa efuaua, sakedote lopia faꞌa ega pinauga auga aina kaina kaina efoua.
Kai Iesu ega imoi epainiꞌi einaka, “Amoapakipo, egaꞌina folokapa,” eoma. Ke egaꞌina auga aina eafi opogaina epafelo.

Egae kai Iesu sakedote lopiaꞌi, Deo ega eꞌa keꞌima kaniagai auꞌi, ke Iudea au akaikiꞌaꞌi isa kegaafia keoma kemai auꞌi epainiꞌi einaka, “Lau painao auꞌi koa iꞌopoꞌi oi eemiai kelele akaikiꞌa agaꞌo lakapaisa ma puo, ifani aꞌifaꞌi kopi fou oafiiꞌi omai amoafiau ooma?

Aufa kina mo oi fou Deo ega eꞌai aagu kai, imami agaꞌomo ganinagai faagauai aloogeaua. Kai pau Deo ega logoai Satani umina ipauma auga elogoaina fepinauga auga, kina emai efua. Ega puo kapaꞌina lau faagauai amokapa ooma auga okapa,” eoma.
Peto Iesu Epuniaiaina
Egae kai isa Iesu keafiia kegopeisa kepapea kelaoainia mo, sakedote lopia faꞌa ega eꞌai kekokoaina. Ega aisama Peto isafa isa muniꞌiai aakai mo epea elaoaina.
Egaꞌina afegai ifani auꞌi iifa ipakaina afuga ipuainagai lo kepaaga keagu lofe. Ega aisama Peto isafa isa fou egae keagu.
Egae kalaꞌafi ifiaoga agaꞌo lo eaeagai Peto eagu auga eisa. Ke isa eisa felo aisama eifa einaka, “Iꞌina auga Iesu fou keagu auga agaꞌo,” eoma.
Kai Peto epuniai einaka, “Laaꞌi, lau isa alalogonia,” eoma.
Ke keagu afaꞌagamo aisama, aufalao agaꞌo Peto eisa felo puo epainia einaka, “Oi isafa Iesu ega imoi agaꞌo,” eoma. Kai Peto iifa epamue einaka, “Lau laaꞌi!” eoma.
Ke kina maaga agaꞌo elao afegai, aufalao iꞌoina agaꞌo Peto ega niniꞌani aꞌo elogonia aisama eifa faꞌiꞌi einaka, “Iꞌina auga Kalilea auga. Koꞌa ipauma isa Iesu fou kelao kemaimai auga agaꞌo,” eoma.
Kai Peto iifa epamue einaka, “Laaꞌi, oi kapaꞌina loifania auga oko alalogo!” eoma. Peto eniniꞌani laolao kai oꞌolo eagaga.

Ega aisama Lopia Iesu egae eapa eꞌafoaipini maaga opainai elao Peto eisa. Ke fiakoa mo Peto Lopia ega niniꞌaniai eifa, ‘Pau oꞌolo aeagaga koa kai lau alopuniaiainiau oiso alopamia,’ eoma auga iifaga eopolaga.
Ega aisama Peto egaꞌina afugai epealai elao afegai kai eapepe alogaina.
Ifani Auꞌi Iesu Kepaꞌaua Keauniia
Ifani auꞌi Iesu keꞌima auꞌi keꞌina Iesu kepaꞌaua ke keauniia.
Ke maaga tiapuai kemokaisa kai kepaꞌani penia keinaka, “Kaisau oi eaunio auga profeta koa momia moifania,” keoma.
Ke egaꞌina mo akekapaiꞌi kai niniꞌani apalaꞌi isafa maꞌo eegai keifaniꞌi.
Iesu Iifa Ipakaina Afugai Kekokoaina
Egani aisama, iifa ipakaina afugai au akaikiꞌaꞌi auꞌi, sakedote lopiaꞌi, ke Moses ega iifa pamalelega auꞌi fou kemai kelaꞌafou. Egae kai Iesu kemaiseina agoꞌiai kepaapa.
Ke kepaꞌani penia keinaka, “Oi Mesaia koa aisama maamaisai moifa gomeisa mo,” keoma. Ke Iesu einaka, “Lau alaifa gomeisa mo ganinagai, afolopakoꞌaniau.
Ke Mesaia kaisau auga paꞌanina alapaꞌani koa aisama, eꞌu iifa afa afolopamue.
Kai pau iina kina agelao alogai, Papiau Aumauni Gauga Deo isapu akaikiꞌa ipauma auga, ima kaina kainai ageagu agoisa,” eoma.
Ega aisama maꞌoai Iesu kepaꞌani penia keinaka, “Ega koa aisama, oi Deo Gauga ma?” keoma. Ke Iesu einaka, “Oi oifania auga koꞌa. Lau Deo Gauga paisa,” eoma.

Ega aisama keifa keinaka, “Ifo akegai eifa isa Deo Gauga eoma. Egaꞌina auga Deo eegai eifa apala puo femae. Lai ifomai ainamaisai eifa aꞌo alogonia efua. Ega puo papiau agaꞌo isa fepaꞌani penia ifo fouga feifania pugu auga apamafua,” keoma.
